steps.content: The same dizzying, world-turning sensation overwhelms you. When you open your eyes again, you find yourself engulfed in chaos.
Inside, corrupted forms swarm and jostle, a ravenous tide desperate to consume you.
But the power of the shackles flares, creating a barrier that forces the horde to keep its distance, circling hungrily just beyond reach.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: This place... is full of them?! There are too many...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: And the exit... I can't get a fix on anything in this mess!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A rift reacts to strong emotions... desires. Try focusing on what you want most right now. It might... show you the way.
The three sisters exchange glances, then close their eyes.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: What we desire most... is to return to our world.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: With Dad's painting...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: ...And all of us together!
A few seconds of silence pass. Then, the entire rift shudders with violent force. Every contaminant in the void surges forward, converging into a single, frantic mass before you.
They swell, expand, and devour one another, merging into a single, grotesque entity!
It grows and grows until, like an overfilled balloon, it ruptures. A wave of pure Mania explodes outward with an ear-splitting shriek.
As the ringing fades, you take in your surroundings again...
There, in the distance, a colossal, fox-like creature stands sentinel before a radiant, white light.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's... a congealed mass of all this Mania contamination!
The Mania contamination born from the three sisters' longing has taken their form, blocking the path home.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: No matter who we face, we won't lose.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Agreed. Would you show us how to use this power, Chief?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: You're not stopping us, you big bully!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright. Then I promise... I'll see you all home safely.
